tip.title: Start with something to sew
tip.body: Open a picture, draw a shape or type a monogram. This step ticks when your canvas has something on it.

tip.title: Make it fit the hoop
tip.body: Set the width, then check the hoop. This step ticks when the design fits inside the sewing area.

tip.title: Tune the stitches
tip.body: Tell Lilo your fabric and thread. This step ticks when Lilo sees no quality problems, like stitches packed too close.

tip.title: Watch it sew first
tip.body: Press Play, or look at the realistic view. This step ticks when you have done either.

tip.title: Send it to the machine
tip.body: Send it over Wi-Fi, or save a file for a USB stick. This step ticks once you have done either.
